map.旋耕亩耗油约 0.9 L/亩，则 100 亩油耗 = 100 × 0.9 = 9: Rotary tillage ~0.9 L/mu, so 100 mu = 100 x 0.9 = 90 L. At 7.5 yuan/L diesel, fuel cost ~ 675 yuan. Heavy operations like subsoiling reach 1.5-2.0 L/mu.
map.亩耗油受哪些因素影响？: What factors affect per-mu fuel use?
map.土壤墒情（越湿越黏越费油）、耕深、档位与转速匹配、轮胎气压、机具锐利度都会影响。: Soil moisture (wetter/stickier uses more), tillage depth, gear-rpm matching, tire pressure, and implement sharpness all matter. Average multiple passes on the same plot for stability.
map.油耗能直接算作业成本吗？: Can fuel use directly give operation cost?
map.不能，还需加上人工、折旧、维修。一般燃油约占机械作业变动成本的 30%~50%，: No; add labor, depreciation, and repair. Fuel is typically 30%-50% of variable machinery cost, the largest single item, so set a fuel baseline first.
